summary: Ship checksummed GitHub Release binaries, no-Go installers, and a user-owned browser-auth boundary for the supported platforms.
reason: Normal users need an auditable installation path that never falls back to Go, while authentication stays outside the agent handling the installation.
validated_outcome: Four deterministic target archives passed checksum, format, embedded-version, native CLI, native MCP, installer, onboarding, shellcheck, and actionlint verification.
